class.name: MaszynaE3DRoadVehicleRenderingServer
class.description: A [RoadVehicleRenderingServer] whose cars' lamps are lit as their lights are on ([method RoadVehicleController.get_lights]), by the names of the original's lamp submodels: the head lights the front end's headlamps, the tail lights the rear end's red markers. Registered by the plugin under the core's name.
